title: What to Do When Play Is Suspended Due to a Thunderstorm
question: What must you do with your ball if play is stopped because of a thunderstorm warning signal?

choices.text: Leave it where it is and return to the clubhouse
Pick it up and take it with you without marking
Mark its position, lift it, and replace it later
Play your shot quickly before leaving

explanation: You must mark where your ball lies, lift it, and later return it to exactly the same spot when play resumes.
